:''If you were looking for the character with the Japanese name Kurt from [[M13|the thirteenth movie]], see [[Karl]].'' ---- {{CharInfobox |color={{Poké Balls color}} |corecolor={{Poké Balls color light}} |bordercolor={{Poké Balls color dark}} |name=Kurt |jname=ガンテツ |tmname=Gantetsu |image=HeartGold SoulSilver Kurt.png |size=200px |caption=Artwork from ''{{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}}'' |gender=Male |hometown=[[Azalea Town]] |region=[[Johto]] |colors=yes |eyes=Black |hair=Gray |relatives=[[Maizie]] (granddaughter) |trainer=no |game=yes |generation={{Gen|II}}, {{Gen|IV}} |games=[[Pokémon Gold and Silver Versions|Gold, Silver]], {{v2|Crystal}}, [[Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver Versions|HeartGold, SoulSilver]] |leader=no |anime=yes |epnum=EP142 |epname=A Shadow of a Drought |enva=[[Carter Cathcart|Jimmy Zoppi]] |java=[[Masashi Hirose]] }} '''Kurt''' (Japanese: '''ガンテツ''' ''Gantetsu'') is a [[Poké Ball]] smith who lives in [[Azalea Town]]. In addition to making his own custom Balls out of [[Apricorn]]s, he studies Poké Ball mechanics, and is known far and wide as a Poké Ball expert. He is [[Maizie]]'s grandfather. ==In the core series games== Kurt lives in a house in the northwest corner of [[Azalea Town]] in {{game3|Gold and Silver|Pokémon Gold, Silver|s}}, {{v2|Crystal}}, {{game3|HeartGold and SoulSilver|HeartGold, and SoulSilver|s}}. After [[Team Rocket]] is cleared out of the [[Slowpoke Well]], he gives the player a [[Lure Ball]] (in Gold, Silver, and Crystal) or a [[Fast Ball]] (in HeartGold and SoulSilver). After this, he offers to make his [[Apricorn]] Balls as long as he is brought an Apricorn. By the next day, he will have crafted it into one of his custom [[Poké Ball]]s, depending on the color of the Apricorn. In Crystal, HeartGold, and SoulSilver, he allows the player to give him multiples of one kind of Apricorn, which allows more than one of his special Poké Balls to be obtained per day. Additionally, in Crystal, when the player obtains the [[GS Ball]], Kurt will examine it for a day if it is brought to him. Finding [[Ilex Forest]] restless after this, he asks the player to check things out. After that, {{p|Celebi}} can be caught in the forest. In his house, there is a picture of Kurt, [[Professor Oak]], and [[Agatha|a lady with determined eyes]]. In [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon]], Kurt is [[List of cross-generational references|mentioned]] by an old man in the [[Heahea City#Akala Ferry Terminal|Akala Ferry Terminal]]. He describes him as "the masterful Poké Ball smith who is the pride of the [[Johto]] region" and talks about the GS Ball, which he suggests may stand for "greatest smith's ball". Kurt is also referenced in [[The Isle of Armor]] in [[Pokémon Sword and Shield]]: when the player obtains a rare Poké Ball from the [[Cram-o-matic]] for the first time, [[Hyde]] says that a "real old guy" who is friends with [[Mustard]] once visited to make such Poké Balls for him. In [[Pokémon Legends: Z-A]], a woman on a rooftop says that she wants to collect Kurt's Poké Balls and put them on display together. ==Gallery== ===Artwork=== {|style="margin:auto;text-align:center;{{roundy|20px}}border:2px solid #{{Poké Balls color dark}};background:#{{Poké Balls color}};font-size:80%" |- |style="{{roundy|20px}}border:2px solid #{{Poké Balls color dark}};background:#{{Poké Balls color light}};width:96px;height:96px"|[[File:Gold Silver Kurt.png|115px]] |- |Official artwork from

Try catching Pokémon with it."'' ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Kurt anime.png|thumb|250px|Kurt in {{aniseries|GS}}]] ====History==== ====={{aniseries|OS}}===== Kurt was first mentioned in ''[[EP116|The Rivalry Revival]]'', where {{an|Professor Oak}} showed {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} a picture of him and told them to deliver the [[GS Ball]] to him for studying. ====={{aniseries|GS}}===== Kurt made his physical debut in the {{aniseries|GS}} episode ''[[EP142|A Shadow of a Drought]]''. After Ash had accidentally stepped on one of [[Azalea Town]]'s {{p|Slowpoke}}, Kurt disguised Ash and his friends as Slowpoke to avoid the angry townspeople. He then told them that he had been investigating strange sounds coming from the [[Slowpoke Well]], which later turned out to be caused by the activities of {{TRT}}. After Ash and his friends had foiled Team Rocket's plan to steal all the local Slowpoke, they were surprised to learn Kurt's identity as the man they had been supposed to meet. In ''[[EP143|Going Apricorn!]]'', Ash gave the GS Ball to Kurt, who agreed to study it. Afterwards, he demonstrated Ash, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} his ability to make custom [[Poké Ball]]s out of [[Apricorn]]s, and gave each of them a [[Fast Ball]]. After a trip through a nearby forest, the group also gave Kurt two [[Blue Apricorn]]s and one [[Black Apricorn]] to be fashioned into Poké Balls. The completed Poké Balls were delivered to the group by [[Maizie]] in the [[EP144|next episode]], with Ash and Misty each taking one of the [[Lure Ball]]s and Brock taking the [[Heavy Ball]]. In ''[[EP145|A Farfetch'd Tale]]'', Professor Oak mentioned that he hoped Kurt would be able to solve the mystery of the GS Ball. ====Character==== Kurt is regarded as an expert in [[Poké Ball]]s, and specializes in crafting [[Apricorn]] Balls. He is often working extensive hours trying to meet customer demands, though he enjoys the process and required attention to detail to achieve a good product. Despite his gruff nature, he is a generous individual who adores his granddaughter [[Maizie]], who he is currently mentoring to make Apricorn Balls. ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{Poké Balls color}}|bordercolor={{Poké Balls color light}} |ja=広瀬正志 ''[[Masashi Hirose]]'' |en=[[Carter Cathcart|Jimmy Zoppi]] |ar=جمال حمدان ''Jamal Hamdan'' |fr_eu=Benoît Van Dorslaer |he=יורם יוספסברג ''Yoram Yosephsberg'' |it=Marco Pagani (Mediaset dub)
Mario Scarabelli ({{TPCi}} dub) |pt_br=Sílvio Giraldi |es_eu=Luis Gaspar |pl=Jacek Kałucki}} ==In the manga== [[File:Kurt JBA.png|thumb|left|120px|Kurt in Pocket Monsters HGSS Jō's Big Adventure]] ===Pocket Monsters HGSS Jō's Big Adventure=== Kurt appeared in [[Pocket Monsters HGSS Jō's Big Adventure]]. When he witnessed [[Team Rocket]] stealing the {{p|Slowpoke}} and cutting off their tails, he came to the Slowpoke's rescue. He tried stopping Team Rocket but is pushed back by one of the members. ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Kurt Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Kurt in Pokémon Adventures]] ====History==== =====Past===== In their youth, {{adv|Professor Oak}}, [[Agatha]], Kurt, [[Pryce]], and the old couple who run the [[Goldenrod City]] [[Pokémon Day Care]] were all close friends. To try to cheer Pryce up, Kurt helped write the lyrics of "[[Boy and his Lapras]]", which was also sung by [[DJ Mary]] after that. ====={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===== {{adv|Silver}} got a Heavy Ball from Kurt and intended to catch an {{p|Ursaring}} with it. Kurt cautioned Silver that only experienced {{pkmn|Trainer}}s could wield his special Poké Balls. Later, {{adv|Gold}} met [[Maizie]] and Kurt. Kurt explained that once, his ancestors were the only ones capable of creating Poké Balls until companies started to mass-produce them. Kurt then carried a slight grudge against Gold for making fun of his Apricorn Balls, saying that Gold wasn't experienced enough to use his special Balls, something that annoyed Gold. He then challenged Gold to catch a Pokémon using one of his balls and if he couldn't by dusk, he would have to become his apprentice, which he accepted. Kurt made a [[Friend Ball]] for Gold, and later Gold and Silver were able to use their custom Poké Balls to capture a {{p|Teddiursa}} and Ursaring. Silver kept Ursaring for himself while Gold gave Teddiursa to Maizie. Kurt then appeared at [[Slowpoke Well]], to see a mass of {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s tied up and defeated, everyone wondering who did it. Later, the [[Masked Man]] forced Kurt to turn over his plans for the GS Ball. ====={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===== Both Kurt and Maizie made a cameo appearance in ''[[PS337|Epilogue]]'' aboard the [[S.S. Aqua]] on their way to the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. ====={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}===== While Kurt was not seen in person, in a bonus page of {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|52}}, a schedule for the Aspertia Trainers' School revealed that Kurt teaches on Ball Studies ('''ボール学''' ''Ball Studies''). ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Kurt's Pokémon in the Pokémon Adventures manga. {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kurt |pkmn=Shuckle |type1=Bug |type2=Rock |img=Kurt Shuckle Adventures.png |epnum=PS101 |epname=Teddiursa's Picnic |desc={{p|Shuckle}} is Kurt's only known Pokémon. It was assisting Kurt on making the special Poké Balls from the Apricorns given to him. None of Shuckle's moves are known.}} ===Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys=== Kurt appeared in ''[[GB07|The Great Search! Let's Rescue The Slowpoke!]]''. Following [[Team Rocket]] infiltrating the [[Slowpoke Well]], Kurt tried to stop them, but injured his back. When the well started to flood, Kurt gave {{GnB|Gold}} some of his [[Apricorn]] [[Poké Ball]]s to save the well's Slowpoke from drowning. Afterwards, Kurt gave Gold a [[Level Ball]] as thanks. Kurt also appeared in a flashback in ''[[GB23|Let's Fight For The Future!!]]''. ===Pokémon HeartGold SoulSilver: Pokédex Completion Comic=== [[File:Kurt PCC.png|thumb|120px|Kurt in Pokémon HeartGold SoulSilver: Pokédex Completion Comic]] Kurt briefly appeared in [[Pokémon HeartGold SoulSilver: Pokédex Completion Comic]]. ===Pokémon Pocket Monsters=== [[File:Kurt PM.png|thumb|left|220px|Kurt in Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] Kurt appears in ''[[PM078|Find Slowpoke!!]]'', where a {{p|Slowpoke}} of his was stolen. He was able to retrieve the Slowpoke from {{PPM|Giovanni}} before he was able to get the tail for profit. However, the tail was cut off while stolen but it was able to get placed back on. He reappears in [[PMHGSS04]]. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kurt |width=72 |pkmn=Slowpoke |type1=Water |type2=Psychic |img=Kurt Slowpoke PM.png |epnum=PM078 |epname=Find Slowpoke!! |desc={{p|Slowpoke}} is Kurt's only known Pokémon. It was stolen by Giovanni and Team Rocket along with the Slowpoke at the Slowpoke well in order to get their tails for profit. Kurt was able to rescue his Slowpoke before its tail was sold.
